issue_context.title: Exporting Named enum values is shown out of order in editor
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0-alpha

### System information

Windows 10

### Issue description

Using a named enum as value for an exported variable shows the elements out of order in the editor. Also, the order changes with each loading of the scene.

This example:
```
enum EnumTest{TEST_1, TEST_2, TEST_3, TEST_4, TEST_7}
@export var choose_type: EnumTest = 0

func _ready():
	print(choose_type == EnumTest.TEST_3)
```
brings:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25422687/144344977-74d0c43d-bedc-4cd1-8fd2-000bb83cd84f.png)


I know that we can use something like `@export_enum(TEST_1, TEST_2, TEST_3, TEST_4, TEST_7) var choose_type: int`, but you will need to create an enum with these same values to check equality in the script.






### Steps to reproduce

Following the docs (https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/tutorials/scripting/gdscript/gdscript_exports.html?highlight=exporting%20variable#named-enum-values):

Create a named enum, and use it as value for an exported variable and check it's order in the editor.

Example:
```
enum EnumTest{TEST_1, TEST_2, TEST_3, TEST_4, TEST_7}
@export var choose_type: EnumTest = 0
```







### Minimal reproduction project

[export_enum_order_problem.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/7638418/export_enum_order_problem.zip)
